verdict.rationale: LangGraph is open-source (pip install), with self-managed checkpointers (e.g., PostgresSaver) for persistence, a CLI to run the Agent Server locally, and nodes/tools that are plain functions requiring no vendor API calls, allowing fully self-hosted operation independent of LangSmith/LangGraph Platform. missing for 10: no independent case study of a large-scale fully self-hosted production deployment, and community notes (langgraph-comm-7) show some ambiguity/questions about production-grade self-hosted deployment tooling beyond 'langgraph serve'.
